column1: # 32_21_tinyusb pinned downloads (tab separated; columns in lib/boxtool.bash). Checked 2026-10-25.
# TinyUSB + the MCU deps its tools/get_deps.py would git-clone (same commits, fetched as GitHub
# commit archives): no checksum published upstream -> sha256 TOFU 2026-10-25.
# 2026-10-29: nrfx, ST G4/H5/H7 CMSIS+HAL, stm32-tcpp0203, Pico-PIO-USB added the same way, for nRF52840,
# WeAct G431/H562/H743 and the Pico PIO-USB host. Source of truth = the commit hash in tools/get_deps.py of the
# tagged TinyUSB 0.21.0 release (the combination TinyUSB tests). Three of them are also upstream tags: nrfx v3.14.0,
# cmsis_device_h5 v1.7.0, stm32-tcpp0203 v1.2.3; the other six sit between upstream tags (no tag on that commit).
# GitHub publishes no digest for commit archives: each archive was checked file by file against `git fetch
# --depth 1 <commit>` (identical trees, 2026-10-29); the sha256 below were taken from those verified archives.
# pico-sdk, picotool, pico-sdk-tools: sha256 = GitHub release asset digest.
# arm-none-eabi-gcc: sha256 from the .sha files xPack publishes next to each asset.
# Bend 2.0.39 (Apache-2.0), group "bend": installed by `install` (not bootstrap), only for examples/bend_usb_crc
# (host-side laws/proofs; Bend has no MCU target). sha256 = GitHub release asset digests
# (gh api repos/bendlang/bend/releases/tags/v2.0.39). Run through `./tinyusb-box bend`, never directly.
